img.caption: The farm running: bonders at the end of the long shadow (flag 3), the player just south of the Portal Wraiths, the Keystone on the far edge of the aggro bubble (flag 1).

blocks.p: Legendary Survivor in about 4 hours, or 534 skill points a day. Normal mode, {mission:527}; about 8 minutes to set up, then it runs indefinitely.

ul: A Chaos Rift spawns 8 Titans every 30 seconds, and you tank them.
Your health is set so each hit does only 1 damage, under {skill:263} and the Lightbringer title.
Two Monk heroes keep the bond up and heal the conditions; that 1 damage pays their energy back through {skill:250}.
A {skill:63} Mesmer hero kills. The rest of the party stays away, so the XP is split only two ways.

builds.name: Player
builds.note: Any profession. 5 Leadership from an "of the Paragon" mod; health by LB rank (table below).

builds.name: Prot Bonder
builds.note: Bonds first. 16 Protection (18 after Heroic Refrain), 7 Divine Favor.

builds.name: Heal Bonder
builds.note: Bonds second. 16 Healing (18 after Heroic Refrain), 11 Protection (13 after Heroic Refrain), 7 Divine Favor.

builds.name: Keystone
builds.note: 16 Fast Casting, 15 Inspiration with runes. No weapon.

blocks.p: As an alternative at LB4 and up, you can be the third bonder instead of using Heroic Refrain. Two bonders need 18 and 13 Protection, but three can do with 13, 8 and 3: the Prot Bonder at 13, the Heal Bonder at 8 and you at 3, bonding in that order.

builds.name: Player
builds.note: Monk secondary with 3 Protection. Balthazar's Spirit fully pays for your share of the bond.

blocks.p: The cost: without Heroic Refrain's +2, Purifying Veil and Mending are weaker, so conditions last longer and Mending gives less health regeneration. That's a little less safe at high LB, and still fine at LB4.

ul: Put these 3 heroes first in the party, so each can be flagged.
Bonders: all bonds disabled, about 50 energy.

blocks.p: Wear a low-armor set (from Banoit, Kambei, Moon Ahn, Nu Leng or Mehinu), with health by LB rank:

head: LB¹
Target HP²
With morale³
How
Correction for Dervishes⁴
rows: 5 superior runes, Survivor chest and head
notes: ¹ For LB2 or LB3, see the full guide linked at the end of the page.
² Up to 20 HP over the target is fine: hits then do 2 damage.
³ After closing the Torment rift (+2% morale).
⁴ Dervishes get +25 health from their chest piece.

ul: Energy: "of the Necromancer" weapons on both bonders.
Health: a +1/20% Protection item on the Prot Bonder, recasting Purifying Veil until it lands at 62%, which cuts Burning to 2 seconds.

img.caption: The path, and the compass once everyone is in place.

blocks.p: Fight your way to the Chaos Rifts.

ul: The 3 Portal Wraiths at the Torment rift (left, south): +2% morale.
The 3 Torment creatures and 2 Margonites patrolling.
The 2 Titan Abominations: killed ones respawn.
The 3 Portal Wraiths at the Titan rift (right, north): if all die, the Titans stop.
Everything further west: closing another rift adds morale and throws off your health.

ol: Flag the bonders and the Keystone at the tip of the long shadow; flag everyone else out of compass range.
Wield the "of the Paragon" weapon. Heroic Refrain each bonder in turn, and let it put its 4 enchantments on you.
Switch to the low-health set, check your health, then reactivate the Lightbringer title.
Aggro the Titans and stand just south of the Portal Wraiths, without aggroing them.
Flag the Keystone to the edge of your aggro bubble, away from the Wraiths, and use the scroll.

blocks.p: Watch a couple of Madness Titan cycles: they bleed and burn you, and their holy damage gives no Essence Bond energy. If your health and the bonders' energy hold, go AFK.
